title: The Bishop Opens the Line
setup: Black's king is stuck in the a8 corner, and the black pawn on c2 is one step from promoting. Mate comes first.
hint: One of your pieces is standing on the file your rook needs. Give it a job that moves it and checks at the same time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bd5+}} clears b3 and checks; {{Rb7+}} pushes the king back into the corner; {{Qa6#}} mates down the a-file, the bishop on d5 now holding the rook on b7. Every move in a hunt should both check and improve the net.
